name: Check Point Harmony Email and Collaboration
summary: Event query envelope from the integration fixture. The product API guide is not open.
notes: Harmony Email API pages sit behind a Check Point login. The fixture uses responseEnvelope and responseData. This mock returns that envelope with events inside responseData.
The client posts to a command path. This mock answers POST /v1.0/event.
A bearer token from /v2/auth/external is required. That login route is not modeled.
attribution: Checked against a public vendor reference or, when that page is blocked, the integration test fixture plus the public client. See /presets/ATTRIBUTION.md.
